patch_description: Add a second noise-scaled median snap applied to the raw input before the convolution-based weighted regression. The current algorithm only snaps the output after convolution; noise-sized sample-to-sample steps in the raw signal still leak through the window average. Applying a 5-tap median filter to the input (with noise-scale detection) removes impulse-like noise spikes before the window averaging, compounding the smoothing effect on the output (targeting smoothness, currently 0.08) at negligible computational cost since efficiency is saturated (1.00, 0.00s). This stays entirely in the level-domain, noise-scaled mechanism that the history shows beats slope-gating designs - no added slope machinery.
